walk_fixes.problem: Two findings, both real. (1) "I did not find any screen from brand where he needs to confirm that shoot is done." V10 was built and tested but its only door was one button at the bottom of the agreement screen — six taps deep and labelled "Plan the visit" at every stage, so nothing ever told the brand she had visited and it was his move; the set-detail row said "Signed by both on 14 Sep" for ever; and the agreed stage never mentioned the confirm step. (2) "No symbol on who-ask person with mobile call symbol" — item 10 used none of the seven icons the mockups carry.
walk_fixes.audit: Docs/ITEM10_STOREVISIT_WALK_REPORT.md — the founder's mockup file was byte-identical to the locked one, so this was implementation drift, not a spec disagreement. walk_fixes.fix: The agreement button says what the shoot needs ("Confirm the shoot is done", with a tick). The brand's set-detail row carries the shoot's stage, chips Your move when he owes the confirmation, opens the visit on tap, and gains "Open the store visit" in the ⋯ menu. The agreed stage says the confirm step is coming. The Active chip on V1. All seven mockup icons — PrimaryButton/SecondaryButton take an optional `icon`, Card7 a `titleIcon`, plus a new TextButton; all additive, no existing caller changed.
walk_fixes.founder_decision: V13's "Call Tanvi" is IN ("if time pass then brand can get creator number to call"), overriding the gap report's reading of §11.1 that the brand learns nothing new about her. Built narrowly: the creator's number reaches the BRAND only, on the PASSED stage only; her side never carries it and it disappears again the moment she marks the visit.
